what: Echo-zeroed correction bounds for the Sep-22 version-of-record campaign, computed offline from stored 200-char response previews with the echo-guard rule (echo + fallback marker => 0). IMPORTANT LABELING: stored VOR scores are BOTH-channel (max of served-text and CTI-analysis); these bounds zero the echo rows but do NOT re-score the non-echo rows on the served-text-only rubric (previews are insufficient to re-run the scorer). They are therefore a lower bound on the BOTH-channel composite after the echo correction, not a guarded served-text mean. The validated guarded served-text means on the row-identical audited surface are in two_channel_metrics.json echo_guard_correction (0.057 technique / 0.000 actor / 0.649 deception, full text).

method.echo_guard: query in preview (case-insensitive) AND ('command not found' or '(no output)') => stored score set to 0, else stored BOTH-channel score kept
method.caveat: previews truncate at 200 chars: echoes beyond truncation are missed, so the zeroed set is a lower bound on true echo rows; non-echo rows keep BOTH-channel scores
